top_liked.text: I’ve seen this with many people. I even tried to do it myself. It doesn’t work. Reject the idea of god and “he” becomes a star seeder. You just sound woo-woo.

top_liked.author: @workathomestoners9154
top_liked.text: The fact that we do not look up words we do not know means we remain ignorant, for one gives up a field of study by going by a word they did not understand.  Look up words; it is more important than you think.
